title: Positive-dimensional fibres of a proper image of a curve lift to contracted components
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $T,G,Y$ be schemes of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume every irreducible component of $T$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] has topological Krull dimension $1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $r:T\to G$ and $p:G\to Y$ be proper $k$-morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-scheme-over-base], with $r$ surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism]. For any $y\in Y$ whose scheme-theoretic fibre $G_y$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] has positive dimension, $y$ is a closed point [def-weil-closed-points] and there is an irreducible component $Z$ of $T$ such that $(p\circ r)(Z)=\{y\}$ and $\dim r(Z)=1$. Here $r(Z)$ is the image as a subset of $G$, with its subspace topology; it is closed because $r$ is proper. No separatedness over $k$, reducedness, or algebraic-closedness hypothesis on $k$ is imposed.
